caption: The drawing depicts a single goblet composed of two distinct parts: a deep red bowl and a clear base. The bowl is wide at the rim and gradually tapers downward before extending slightly outward near the base. The red coloring is translucent, allowing some light to pass through, giving variation in the intensity of the red. The base of the goblet is clear and circular, supporting the bowl with a short, rounded stem which connects the bowl and the foot. The background of the drawing is a uniform beige color. There is a small horizontal scale near the lower left corner and the name "JOHN DANA" written in the bottom right corner. The goblet is centrally placed on the canvas, and the illustration emphasizes the glass’s shape, proportions, and coloration through shading and highlights.
title: Vase
